places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: Clara gelds fifteen colts with Cholo and July, presses July to bond with Martin, and he decides to stay rather than chase Elmira.
places.location_hint: horse ranch on the Platte about twenty miles from Ogallala, Nebraska

places.name: North Platte River
places.note: Clara watches three cranes fly along its silvery course at sunset.

places.name: Austin
places.note: As a girl there, Clara feared Comanche raids that carried off children.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Clara chides July that he has never lived anywhere but there.

places.name: Missouri
places.note: July met Elmira around a three-day trial there, about two weeks before marrying.

places.name: Richmond
places.note: Clara sometimes dreams of moving there to her aunt and writing books.

places.name: Sioux country
places.note: Elmira has gone into it; Clara says Red Cloud, once fed from their horses, is now fed up.
places.location_hint: plains east of Ogallala, Nebraska, toward which Elmira and Zwey headed

groups.label: Clara's household with July
groups.hint: July has decided to stay on at the ranch on the Platte
